candidates.contract_code:
pub assume_specification<Idx: PartialOrd<Idx>, U>[ RangeFrom::<Idx>::contains ](
    range: &RangeFrom<Idx>,
    item: &U,
) -> (result: bool) where Idx: PartialOrd<U>, U: ?Sized + PartialOrd<Idx>
    ensures
        <Idx as PartialOrdSpec<U>>::obeys_partial_cmp_spec()
            ==> result == range.start.is_le(&item),
;
candidates.rationale: RangeFrom has an included start and unbounded end, so RangeBounds::contains reduces to start <= item, which existing PartialOrd vocabulary models conditionally.
risks: The relation is informative only when the relevant PartialOrdSpec model is obeyed.
